cases.label: Time it by video playback
cases.reason: The video plays far faster than the experiment ran, so only the lab's own clock can time it.

cases.label: Take the scale from another experiment
cases.reason: That scale was measured on a different recording, so the distances are wrong.

cases.label: Use another battery's voltage
cases.reason: That voltage was logged on a different battery, so it can't confirm this one shorted.

cases.label: Outline the whole sample
cases.reason: The outline covers the whole sample, not the filament, so there is nothing real to time.

cases.label: Blur two filaments into one
cases.reason: The outline holds two filaments side by side, so their growth gets mixed together.

cases.label: Cite a number that doesn't exist
cases.reason: No measurement on record backs that number, so it can't be reported.
